title: The Group Chat of the quarry
author: Y. M. Dunmore
blurb: Petra Dravenmoor, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
